headline: Trump’s Trade Negotiator Doubles Down on Tariffs Before Global Duties Expire
context: Jamieson Greer, the president’s top trade negotiator, told the Senate that the United States remained intent on tariffs as it prepared to replace duties the Supreme Court struck down.

sources.name: The New York Times
